exchanges.user: A rule for every email you draft for me: sign "Alex Martin — Northwind", never just "Alex". Right, back to it.
Something else about client emails: never an exclamation mark, and never the phrase "don't hesitate". And when an email mentions an invoice, always restate the client's payment terms. Let's continue.

For amounts in an email: always followed by "excl. VAT", with a comma for thousands, for example £3,750 excl. VAT. By the way, Marston Group pays at 30 days, Marbleton Town Council at 50 days. Pick it up again.
Calendar-wise: I never take a meeting on a Friday, and never before 10 am. Carry on.

Nina Holloway, at Marston Group, I address by her first name; every other client contact I address as Mr or Ms plus their surname. Marston Group did 3 training days at £1,250 a day. Come on, moving on.
Change for my email signature: from now on "Alex — Northwind", without my surname. Back to the topic.
